context: A teacher walks a teen through social research
purpose: Teach: 欠く/相応しい/熟成/建国/伝播/正論/覚醒/呈し

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、欠くべからざる文献、丁寧に、引用していますね、研究、本当に、しっかりしていました、感心です。
lines.en: Sakura, your paper cites all the essential sources with real care. Your research is genuinely thorough — I'm impressed.
lines.style: Warm but measured. Steady eye contact. Each phrase lands with genuine regard. Not gushing — the praise is in the specificity. Slight pause after the compliment, giving it room to land.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。学術論文に、相応しい言葉遣い、心がけました、慎重に、表現を、選びました、本当に、苦労しました、書く時。
lines.en: Thank you. I was really mindful about using language that felt appropriate for an academic paper. I chose every expression carefully — it was exhausting, honestly.
lines.style: Sincere, almost vulnerable in admitting the effort. Slight breathiness on 'exhausting.' Not seeking reassurance, just being honest. Eyes meet hers for a moment, then back to the paper.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史研究、本当に、時間を、熟成させてから、結論、出すこと、必要ですね、桜さん、覚えておいて欲しい、本当に。
lines.en: With historical research, you really do need to let time mature your thinking before you draw conclusions. I'd want you to remember that, Sakura.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost gentle. Speaking from quiet experience. Not lecturing — confiding. A small nod at the end. The tone of someone who has learned this the hard way.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。建国の歴史、神話と、史実を、区別する難しさ、論文の核心でした、本当に、面白いテーマでした、私には。
lines.en: Yes. The core of my paper was actually about how difficult it is to separate myth from historical fact in founding narratives. It was a fascinating theme to dig into.
lines.style: Animated underneath the formality. Real interest lighting up. Not performing — genuinely engaged with her own work. Slight quickening of pace on 'fascinating.'

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文化の伝播、論文の中で、丁寧に、扱われていますね、研究の視野の広さ、評価できますよ、桜さん、本当に、立派です。
lines.en: The way you handled cultural transmission in this paper is really careful and nuanced. The breadth of your perspective — I can genuinely say I'm impressed, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct, warm approval. Leaning forward slightly. Specific words like 'nuanced' and 'breadth' carry weight. Not overdone, but real recognition. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。正論を、振りかざすだけでは、社会、変わらない、と、論文で、論じました、現代にも、繋がるテーマでした、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. In the paper I argued that simply brandishing the right arguments doesn't change society — it has to actually shift people's understanding. It's a theme that connects to our world now too.
lines.style: Quieter, more introspective. The kind of intensity that comes from caring about what you're saying. Slight emphasis on 'society' — this matters to her. Not rehearsed, genuinely believed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の人々が、覚醒していく過程、本当に、印象的でしたね、論文の中で、生き生きと、描かれていました、本当に、感動的でした。
lines.en: The way those people awakened and changed through that era — it came across so vividly in your writing. Really moving, actually.
lines.style: Softer, more personal. Eyes slightly distant, seeing the scenes from the paper. A note of genuine emotion. Not overly effusive, but the sincerity is unmistakable. Warm exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。社会が、新しい姿を、呈し始めた時代、論文で、扱いました、興味深い、転換点でしたね、本当に、深い、研究、できました。
lines.en: Yes. I focused on that pivotal moment when society began to take on a new form. It was such an intriguing turning point to explore — I felt like I could really dig deep into the research.
lines.style: Satisfied but modest. The pride is understated, almost reflexive gratitude for having found something worth exploring. Steady, grounded. A slight trailing-off on 'dig deep,' like she's still caught in that research moment.
